import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    s_length = random.randint(0, 2000)
    p_length = random.randint(0, 2000)

    s = "".join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(s_length))
    p = "".join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase + "?*") for _ in range(p_length))

    return s, p
